review_evidence: The 195 primary Lean files include LeanMLIR dialect definitions/semantics and the Blase verified bitvector/finite-state tooling and theorem development.

LeanMLIR/Dialects/LLVM/Semantics.lean defines poison-aware LLVM integer semantics and proves refinement and operation lemmas; Blase/Fast/Lemmas.lean proves evaluation equivalences and bitstream identities.

Representative large Blase construction, circuit, finite-state-machine, and tactic modules expose reusable definitions and formal interfaces, so subtree-level exclusion would remove unique formal search evidence.
summary: Retain the root subtrees, which contain the LeanMLIR semantics framework and Blase formal developments rather than administrative repository material.
